scripts.typecheck:v2: npm run typecheck -w @zhipanda/api && npm run typecheck -w @zhipanda/api-client
scripts.build:v2: npm run build -w @zhipanda/api-client && npm run build:local -w @zhipanda/api
scripts.check:panda-curation: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen panda-data curation validate
scripts.test:panda-curation: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_curation_validation.py
scripts.process:panda-media: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra media panda-data media process
scripts.test:panda-media: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev --extra media pytest -q tests/test_media_processing.py
scripts.crawler:poc: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra crawler panda-data crawler compare --browser-lab
scripts.crawler:poc:strict: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra crawler panda-data crawler compare --require-browser-lab
scripts.test:crawler-poc: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev --extra crawler pytest -q tests/test_source_runtime.py
scripts.lint:crawler-poc: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev --extra crawler ruff check src/panda_data/acquisition tests/test_source_runtime.py
scripts.source:xi-lun: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen panda-data source run
scripts.source:xi-lun:live: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen panda-data source run --mode live
scripts.test:source-adapters: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/test_source_runtime.py
scripts.test:panda-data: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev --extra media pytest -q
scripts.lint:panda-data: uv run --isolated --directory tools/panda-data --frozen --extra dev --extra media ruff check src tests
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare -w @zhipanda/api && npm run build:cloudflare -w web
